name: general_pulse_sign
reason: Reverse the physical effect-dependent pulse sign.

name: full_carrier_normalization
reason: Remove the required square-root-of-two normalization from both physical pulse terms.

name: matter_control_omitted
reason: Replace the informative physical pulse by the matter-independent program pulse.

name: parity_effect_orientation
reason: Assign the opposite calibrated parity effect to the fixed native Record sign.

name: physical_current_sign
reason: Reverse the physical current dictionary while retaining the independently assembled hopping continuity equation.

name: selective_current_attenuation
reason: Omit the selective incident-current attenuation.

name: incident_energy_support
reason: Use the full protected Hamiltonian in place of its incident odd part.

name: noncommuting_history_order
reason: Reverse the noncommuting sequential history effect.

name: old_record_preservation
reason: Use the first candidate edge as the next control, violating the old Record commutant.

name: Slater_normalizing_Gram
reason: Discard the rank-one Gram denominator in the conditional occupied-space projector.

name: complex_Slater_adjoint
reason: Replace the occupied-orbital adjoint by a transpose for a complex state.

name: Slater_right_filter
reason: Drop the right filter in the conditional covariance.

name: zero_branch_orientation
reason: Label the certain branch as the impossible branch for a constant effect.
